approved_text: For every n ≥ 7, every rank-2 vector bundle on complex projective n-space P^n over ℂ splits as a direct sum of two line bundles. Equivalently, no indecomposable rank-2 vector bundles exist on P^n for n ≥ 7.

source_docstrings:
There are no indecomposable vector bundles of rank 2 on $\mathbb{P}^n$ for $n \ge 7$.
This is Conjecture 6.3 in [Har1974].
source_lean:
theorem harthshorne_conjecture (n : ℕ) (hn : 7 ≤ n)
    (𝓕 : VectorBundles ℙ(Fin (n + 1); Spec (.of ℂ)))
    (h𝓕 : 𝓕.rank = 2) :
    Nonempty (𝓕.Splitting (Fin 2))
